item.title: Army Flying Museum reopens on Friday - Overton Radio
item.description: One of Hampshire's most popular visitor attractions will re-open after a severe electrical power failure.

item.title: Charity Football Match to Bring Saints Legends to Overton - Overton Radio
item.description: Football fans in Overton are being invited to a special charity match next month, featuring a team of local favourites taking on former professional players.

item.title: Palm Sunday Parade to Take Place in Overton - Overton Radio
item.description: Residents are being invited to take part in a special community parade to mark Palm Sunday later this month.

item.title: Churches in Overton Announce Easter Services - Overton Radio
item.description: Churches in Overton have announced a series of services and events to mark Easter, with residents invited to join in moments of reflection, remembrance, and celebration across the Easter weekend.

item.title: Bells Set to Ring Again in Overton After Major Restoration - Overton Radio
item.description: The sound of church bells will soon return to Overton, marking the end of a major restoration project that has kept them silent for months.

item.title: Council backs new rights for rivers in Basingstoke and Deane - Overton Radio
item.description: Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council has stepped up its efforts to protect local rivers and streams across northern Hampshire.

item.title: Easter Party Brings Crafts, Storytelling and Family Fun to Overton - Overton Radio
item.description: Families in Overton are invited to a free Easter celebration filled with creative activities, live storytelling and seasonal fun at the Overton Memorial Institute.

item.title: Stagecoach to Run Sunday Service Across Easter Bank Holiday Weekend - Overton Radio
item.description: Passengers planning travel over the Easter weekend are being advised that Stagecoach will operate a revised timetable, with several days running to a Sunday and public holiday schedule.

item.title: Red Lion to Host St George’s Day Charity Quiz Night - Overton Radio
item.description: The Red Lion is getting set to celebrate St George’s Day with a fun quiz night aimed at bringing the community together and raising money for a good cause.

item.title: Think or Sink Quiz Night Set to Raise Funds for Lordsfield Swimming Club - Overton Radio
item.description: A fun-filled evening of trivia, food and fundraising is coming to Overton next month, as a “Think or Sink” Quiz and Chilli Night takes place in support of Lordsfield Swimming Club.
